description: What enforces each controller rule (repo/CONTROLLER.md and its pages): a hook, a script, a CI check or the programme reconciler, each with the test that proves it and one line on which part of the rule it covers, or instruction-only with the reason. Checked by repo/scripts/check-controller-enforcement-map.cjs.

rows.covers: Governance state decides on or off only from the merged programme file, and the governance hook holds work in a repository whose answer is not yet decided.

rows.rule: Bind one canonical repo, programme, release
rows.instruction_only: Choosing the repository, release and one owning builder is a controller judgement; no code can tell which builder owns an outcome.

rows.covers: The merge hold refuses a merge without the owner's OK. The rest of the fence (binding the named repository, no cross-repository authority) is instruction-only.

rows.instruction_only: Vetting feedback and choosing to extend, reopen or create a child is a judgement; the reconciler records children but does not decide them.

rows.rule: Keep in-flight gates on their admitted Controller revision
rows.instruction_only: No launcher records the controller revision a gate was admitted on, so nothing can compare it.

rows.covers: The reconciler works out each child's group (Now, Later, optional) and the parent's order; it does not keep owners or commitments.
The reconciler raises TASK_IDLE and TASK_MERGED_OPEN for NOW tasks nothing is moving, refuses to acknowledge them and lists them first; picking the lane or next step is the controller's judgement.

rows.instruction_only: Whether a fix is small and which slice it joins is a judgement made before any branch exists.
A test pins the wording, but which routes and files are obsolete is a review judgement no check can make.

rows.rule: On "you are taking over as controller for <repo>"
rows.covers: The reconciler's takeover claim stops the old writer before its next write. The capability check and the journey are instruction-only.

rows.rule: Beneath explicit owner authority and platform instructions
rows.instruction_only: Instruction precedence and what a session loads are read by the agent; no hook sees which instructions it followed.

rows.rule: An authorised in-gate refresh reads changed sources
rows.instruction_only: The refresh notice and the choice not to restart happen inside the session; nothing outside it can check them.
What a return says is free text read by the controller; no schema checks it.

rows.rule: Routines/executors ask the owner only when the owner must act
rows.instruction_only: Whether the owner must act is a judgement per message.

rows.covers: The reconciler keeps each programme finding with its controller next action until it is answered, and the Projects daily check-in turns failing tasks, PRs that need a step and long-missing project tasks into first-line prefixes the coordinator must act on. Judging the action and deadline for any other finding is the controller's.

rows.instruction_only: Native host controls hold standing authority; Toolkit code records none of it and cannot see uncertain effects.

rows.covers: The merge hold and the auto-merge check stop merges without the owner's OK or a passing check. Deletions, keys and other irreversible steps are instruction-only.
The merge hold lets merges into an evidence store through without asking. Secret scans and the sole-copy rule are instruction-only.

rows.rule: These pages are part of this file
rows.covers: The pages check fails when a page is missing, unlisted, out of step with its hash or has a rule with two homes.
The pages check fails when this page is missing or its hash is stale.
The pages check fails when this page is missing or its hash is stale.
The pages check fails when this page is missing or its hash is stale.
Stack selection resolves each role and the reviewer set only from the pinned registry, with no default or fallback.

rows.rule: Launch every gate with model and effort pinned explicitly
rows.instruction_only: Gates start from Projects threads, Remote Control or a person; no Toolkit launcher starts them, so there is nothing to hook a route check to.
A gatekeeper is a session the controller opens by hand; no Toolkit launcher starts it, so its tier cannot be checked.

rows.covers: The merge-train script's verify lists the files two or more members change, so the controller sees when a train needs a delta review; a hand-resolved or edited merge fails verify, so a lane cannot fix a conflict inside the train. The lane's model tier and skipping G0 and G1 stay instruction-only.

The helper guard checks a helper launch against its pinned route and refuses one that would launch another agent, when a host hook calls it; the depth setting keeps spawn depth at one. Reading run logs is instruction-only.

rows.instruction_only: The service tier is chosen in the host when a session starts; Toolkit has no setting to check.

rows.covers: Stack selection resolves the full reviewer set from the same selection. When G2 starts, fresh contexts and independence are instruction-only.

rows.rule: The owner may address G0/G1 directly
rows.instruction_only: Whether a relay is faithful and which input is stale is read by the gate; no record carries it.

rows.covers: The reconciler records each child's gate state from its checkpoints and flags a stale or competing one. Reusing a session and consuming a return once are instruction-only.
The auto-merge check needs a UAT line on the pull request, and the reconciler records UAT retained, partial or full. Deciding which steps need owner UAT is instruction-only.

rows.instruction_only: Whether a feature needs an invariant model is a G0 judgement that G2 checks by reading.

rows.covers: The decision history reads the SCOPE-CONFIRMED tag as the owner's confirmation of a child's scope. Asking the owner is instruction-only.

rows.rule: G2 tests scope, execution, security and evidence
rows.instruction_only: Rating findings is the reviewer's judgement.
Readable text is judged by G1 and G2; the plain-reference check covers only issue and PR references in docs.
No Toolkit code publishes progress with conditional writes and readback; the programme checkpoint script writes only a local journal.
Whether work is finished is a judgement at the end of each turn.

rows.rule: Reuse the user-selected private evidence store
rows.covers: Governance discovery lists the owner's existing private evidence stores before proposing a new one, and a name alone selects nothing. Verifying access through the backend is instruction-only.

rows.instruction_only: Which files to archive and when is a judgement at gate end; the push and fetch use plain Git.
The workspace residue report lists worktrees and branches that are safe to remove by this rule's tests, but nothing runs it automatically or stops a forced removal.

rows.covers: The merge-train script refuses a train that holds anything but member merges at their reviewed heads, clean main catch-up merges and one reproducible bump, and its land check refuses a moved main, a moved member head or a RISKY member with no owner OK. Choosing which PRs ride together and running the merge stay instruction-only.

rows.instruction_only: Promises live in free text (PR, issue comments or project memory); the hourly nudge reads them, but no code parses them.
Which action fits a finding, and when a repeat or missed deadline needs the owner, is a judgement per finding; the check-in prefixes and programme attention that feed it are mapped on the core rule.

rows.rule: Native coverage: Codex/Claude Code on real selected paths
rows.instruction_only: The rule itself says host qualification is not implemented. Install health checks only that installed copies, hooks and helper files are current, not the listed host behaviours.
